_comment: ADR-0109 lifecycle-status gate policy. ONE required lane over EVERY config in configs_dir, replacing the nine tools/oya-governance-*-lifecycle-app dev-CLI crates that were never referenced by .github/workflows/** and therefore enforced nothing for their entire lifetime. Adding a lifecycle is a CONFIG file here, never a new crate; the completeness dimension makes an unevaluated config fail closed, so a lane cannot be born dark the way the nine dev-CLIs were. MEASURED on the live corpus at first wiring: only 2 of the 9 declared lifecycles observe anything at all.
purpose: ADR-0109 lifecycle state-machine ratchet: every declared lifecycle config is evaluated against the live corpus, per (lane, violation_kind) counts are frozen shrink-only, and a lane that cannot see its corpus is blocking rather than vacuously green.

frozen_violation_baseline._comment: FROZEN shrink-only per (lane, violation_kind) counts, MEASURED against the live corpus. An absent pair is born-blocking; growth is a regression; a count that FALLS makes this baseline stale and must shrink in the same reviewed PR, so a fixed violation cannot leave headroom for the next one. Only the two lanes that actually observe a corpus appear here — the other seven are in known_broken_lanes and are deliberately unbaselined, because a baseline over an unobservable corpus certifies nothing.

adr-status-lifecycle._comment: Live apex ADRs only (docs/decisions/ADR-*.md post-disposition). All carry readable status scalars; historical corpus is under docs/adr-archive/ outside this source glob. Zero-count pairs omitted (absent pair is already born-blocking). Measured 2026-08-06 PR #1574.

doc-status-lifecycle._comment: 2667 docs observed. This is the repo's largest single ungoverned-status corpus and the reason this lane must be a ratchet rather than a flag day: 72% of tracked docs declare no lifecycle stage at all.

known_broken_lanes._comment: Lanes that CANNOT observe a live corpus today. Every one was measured, not assumed. A listed lane may fail discovery or observe zero artifacts without reddening the required context; an UNLISTED lane doing either is born-blocking. Shrink-only in both directions: a listed lane that starts observing artifacts fails with known_broken_lane_now_live and must lose its entry in the same PR, and an entry naming a deleted config also fails. Every entry states a resolution — a defect with no resolution is a permanent excuse, and the parser rejects it. Empty after graduation of api-stability-tier-lifecycle onto registry/catalog and deletion of the six configs whose source roots never existed (or were gitignored). New known_broken entries require a measured defect + resolution string; shrink-only thereafter.
